package.description: Read your Statable analytics from a terminal, a script, or CI

en-US.description: Read your Statable analytics from a terminal, a script, or CI
en-US.longDescription:
The command-line client for Statable, cookieless web analytics hosted in
the EU. It reads visitors, pageviews, sources, pages, goals and funnels
over the Stats API and prints them as a table, JSON or CSV, and it can
create and edit sites, goals and funnels as well. Threshold checks for CI
exit 0 within bounds and 3 outside them.
en-US.name: statable
